Acme Corporation Company Profile

Acme Corp was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in New York City.
The company specializes in manufacturing industrial widgets and enterprise software solutions.

Financial Highlights:
- Total revenue in Q1 2024: $1.2 million
- Total revenue in Q2 2024: $3.1 million
- Total revenue in Q3 2024: $4.2 million (15% increase year-over-year)
- Total revenue in Q4 2024: $2.8 million

Products:
- Widget A: Our flagship industrial component, used by over 10,000 manufacturers worldwide
- Widget B: Next-generation smart widget with IoT connectivity
- Enterprise Suite: Cloud-based management software for widget production

Leadership Team:
- CEO: Jane Smith (since 2015)
- CTO: Bob Johnson (since 2018)
- CFO: Alice Chen (since 2020)

The company employs 5,000 people globally across 12 offices.
Acme Corp is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol ACME.
